name: Muneeb Ur Rehman
title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | .NET & Angular | Enterprise & Platform Systems
summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and delivering complex, data-intensive enterprise systems. I specialize in backend-heavy development using .NET, Angular, SQL, and cloud platforms, with a strong focus on data correctness, security, auditability, and scalability. My experience spans ERP platforms, healthcare billing systems, payroll, POS, and internal business applications. I regularly own features end-to-end — from architecture and implementation to deployment and production support — and have collaborated remotely with international teams on long-lived, business-critical systems.

highlights: Designing and delivering enterprise ERP and financial reporting modules using .NET 9 and modern frontend frameworks.
Owning backend-heavy features end-to-end, including architecture decisions, implementation, and production support.
Implemented a runtime-configurable modular architecture supporting multi-environment deployments.
Built a custom domain-specific language (DSL) using ANTLR and Roslyn to automate workflows and role-based access control.
Developed and optimized high-volume reporting and analytics pipelines for financial and operational use cases.
Automated build and deployment workflows using Docker and GitLab CI/CD, improving release reliability and speed.
Replatformed a legacy healthcare system from Java to .NET 7 using Razor Pages and SQL Server.
Delivered core modules including Claims, Accounts Receivable/Payable, and Patient Management.
Improved SQL performance and UI responsiveness for data-intensive workflows.
Collaborated remotely with U.S.-based stakeholders on delivery and compliance requirements.
Developed an Azure-hosted healthcare reimbursement and billing platform using ASP.NET and Azure SQL.
Integrated Power BI dashboards, RDLC reporting, and Azure Functions for automated file processing.
Implemented role-based access control, encryption, and secure data handling for compliance-focused systems.
Led the design and development of a multi-tenant HRMS and payroll platform supporting business-critical operations.
Implemented complex payroll rules and approval workflows using CQRS and DDD patterns.
Built JWT-secured APIs with fine-grained, field-level authorization.
Integrated biometric and face-recognition devices to automate attendance tracking.
Introduced structured logging and observability using Serilog and Seq, and reduced external vendor dependency.
